runtime: none: code and tests only (no Docker, no database, no provider call)

helper.name: keepWorkerError
helper.writes: one console.warn line: the operation, the dispatching job id and a code; never a message, stack or other text
code: a string own property code matching /^[A-Z0-9_]{1,40}$/

sites.comments: each site's recovery comment from 02fe761b^ restored unchanged, on the line above its .catch(keepWorkerError(...))

tests.replaced: a background worker's error is kept in the log, not discarded (pinned the message text)
tests.added: a background worker's error is kept in the log by its code, never its message
tests.marker: every thrown message holds SECRET_MARKER_TEXT; no warned line contains it; each dispatch resolves to 1

checks.note: the same 15 tests fail before and after on a box without the data drive; processing.test.ts passes 2, skips 2
